name: the Mushroom Patch
description: The Mushroom Patch is a fanciful transport for the citizens of BRC. Five giant mushrooms sprout out of a colorful plush platform which is accessible from all directions. The mushrooms provide shade during the day and glow with brilliantly changing lights at night.

name: The Boob Tube
description: What does every burner in the history of all burners miss the most while on the playa? Television, of course! So... Ladies and germs, freaks, hippies, yuppies, ravers, tech-bros, evil billionaires and everything in-between, the whole spectrum of burnery burnerness -- may we present to you The Boob Tube, Black Rock City's custom-built drivable TV -- bringing joy, merriment, and quality fun-casting to the playa since 2013!
artist: The Boob Tube by Patrick & Evelyn Gleason

name: HEPA Filter
description: The Hardly Effective Playa Anti-dust aka HEPA Filter is a whimsically ineffective device for keeping Black Rock City free of dust while providing rides for lots of burners

name: Uuna Ahi
description: A giant metal fire shooting Moai
artist: Uuna Ahi mutant vehicle by camp WrongoWrongo

name: Bulgarian Kuker
description: Bulgarian KUKER, produced by HitterPetter Production House L.A., represents the 5000 year old Bulgarian tradition of KUKERI RITUAL DANCERS - masked people dressed up in animalistic outfits to scare away evil spirits and bring prosperity and happiness to the village.

name: FL Man Fanboat
description: The Florida Man Fanboat proudly glides across the playa rocking live music and sultry cuddle puddles to sunrise sets at the trash fence every night. A voyage supine, we bump funky beats and furry threads, ferrying you everywhere except Robot Heart.

name: Sphere Car
description: This rolling dance floor is a party on 3 wheels! Lights, music and multiple observations decks. We will be rolling across the play at an unhurried pace gathering up participants as we go. Not to brag but there's even a sink with soap and running water to wash your filthy putrid hands at.

name: F-15 Interceptor - Black Rock Air Force
description:
The Black Rock Air Force's F-15 Interceptor is a 40% scale model of the McDonnell-Douglas F-15D Eagle. On the playa since 2007, it has seen service as an Airport Follow-Me vehicle, Ranger transport, and on reconnaissance missions throughout inner and outer playa. 


It is built on an electric golf cart base and was created using fiberglass, steel, wood, foam, and high-intensity LEDs.
artist: F-15 - Black Rock Air Force by Bryan Lang

name: The Jolly Trolley
description: We're a happy little trolley wanting to meet new friends and offer rides! We may be small out on the playa but don't let that fool you - we have BIG hearts !
artist: The Jolly Trolley by Steve & Shelly Lange

name: Lady Whiskey (aka "Chooch")
description:
The Lady Whiskey, lovingly called “the Chooch” was originally built for Burning Man in 2011, and has evolved through the work of dedicated west coast elves.

She's a 30-foot rusty faux steam locomotive. The concept was inspired by a train graveyard in Bolivia, and originally brought to life by Paul Haugland, Molly Murphy, Philip Beber, Jessica Jensen, Brandon Lortz, Thom Orth, and many others. From Seattle to Oakland, our lovely lady now resides in Vallejo, CA.
artist: Paul Haugland, Molly Murphy, and the Chooch Crew

name: Daddy Long Wheels
description:
This mutant vehicle was built from the ground up specifically for BM.
It looks like a horseless carriage with custom 6 ft. diameter
"old wagon style" wheels. The driver and passengers ride on a big
flat comfortable piece of foam (like a queen size mattress), with a
big foam back support. The vehicle utilizes air-suspension, which can
raise and lower the vehicle like a low rider. When the suspension
is in the full "up" position, the top of the vehicle including the
driver and passengers heads (while seated) are about 10 ft. off the
ground, which makes the vehicle very unique and exciting to look at
and to ride on.
artist: Daddy Long Wheeels by Artist Spencer Buzza

name: Large Marge The Great Pumpkin
description: Large Marge is a spooky carved pumpkin thats comfortable, with lots of lights Halloween decor and candy, trick or treat
artist: Large Marge the Great Pumpkin by Sean Melendrez Sr

name: Sweet Ride (was Candy Cart)
description: The Candy Cart brings much needed calories to burners on the playa and beyond. Look for the gummy bears and stop by for some candy!

name: Passion Flower
description: The Passion Flower marries kinetic, visual, and auditory elements in a multi-sensory experience of music. It is equipped with visceral and visionary artificial intelligence, 360-degree sound, and interactive lighting wrapped in blooming layers of dichroic film, Passion Flower reflects the beauty of its surroundings during the day and emits no exhaust or pollution. At night, its colorful LEDs take over, using lidar technology to automatically match the motion of the crowd and the energy of the music.

name: Disco Snail
description: Micro disco snail built on an electric wheelchair base

name: Cuddle Couch
description: Built for comfort and cruising in style the Cuddle Couch is your safe space to relax with your Burner Amigos and take in all the magic the playa provides.

name: The Wandering Playhouse
description: A moving playground that encourages interactivity and playful nature by allowing users to enjoy dancing, swinging, riding, sliding, and relaxing on The Wandering Playhouse!

name: What's Up Dock
description: What's Up Dock is a southern bayou themed fishing shack and dock.  Join us for a lazy ride winding our way through the streets of Black Rock City and seek adventure on the open playa.  Together we'll reminisce of past burns and tell stories about the one that got away.  And if it breaks down... we'll even let you help push it back to camp!

name: Axolitl
description: Axolotl's Little Buddy -- Axolitl

name: Gramma Dorothy's Loveseat
description: A cozy mobile loveseat to traverse the playa in the comforting vibe of a grandmother's living room. A place to knit, crochet, and relax among the loud and chaotic world around us.

name: BigKrabCar
description: For the 4nd year on Playa we present BigKrabCar, a Krusty and Dusty Krab for your sideways riding adventures, in, around and all the way to the trash fence of Black Rock City 2026!
artist: Big Krab Car by Rowdy Ali

name: SS TaTa
description: Pink boob submarine built for breast cancer awareness and support
artist: SS TaTa by Melissa Christensen and Teddi Baer

name: Thor-Viking Ship
description: Thor-Viking Ship created by Dennis Alumbaugh.  Lighting by Randy Frasier, both of Reno NV.  The car is maintained by members of camp Brand-Ur-Ass n more.
artist: Thor-Viking Ship by Dennis Alumbaugh & Thor Crew

name: El Mango
description: El Mango, a floating mango riding in the middle of the desert.

name: WarPony
description:
An open air 1974 Chevy Blazer with a wooden roof is EXACTLY what we need for our Thunderdome fleet. She's got ridiculous light bars up, down, and sideways. Maybe we'll add some whimsy... like a tire swing - we
haven't had one of those in ... quite some time. WarPony has ample seating for all the folks we can cram on her, and a
little bit more seating on top of that. Please. Please don't sit on the hood. Otherwise, you can scramble all around her
and. Well. Tetanus is at your own risk. She's tall and fun!

name: the vrill society flying saucer
description: our vehicle is a whimsical , stunning , and magical piece of art that stirs the imagination and provokes thought and fun wherever  she goes
artist: the vrill society flying saucer, artist kimo sabe

name: Astral Plain
description: Astral Plain is a warmly lit mutant vehicle designed as a mobile conversation lounge, offering a peaceful and inviting space for introspection, connection, and meaningful dialogue through esoteric experiences.
artist: Astral Plain by Prairie Arts Crew

name: Professor Pigeon
description: Professor Pigeon invites you to travel on their galactic voyage, visiting strange new artwork, and badly going where on pigeon has gone before. Allow yourself to be whisked across the playa in style, to destinations unknown.
artist: Professor Pigeon's Space Voyage by the Pigeon Crew

name: Zulai Art Car
description: Zulai (Tathāgata) is a hand-woven bamboo art car shaped like a giant open palm, carrying a serene Buddha figure at one end. Designed to evoke calmness and security, it glides across the playa as a moving sanctuary. At night, Zulai glows from within, transforming into a luminous beacon of peace.

name: Bone Voyage
description: Extinction couldn't stop us! Prehistoric oasis roaming the dust. Part mammoth, part tropical sanctuary, we invite you to step inside our lounge or ascend to the belly of the beast for chilled drinks and desert views. A nomadic relic connecting the ancient past to the spirit of the playa.
artist: Art Kevorkov, Amazis Solomon & Bone Voyage Crew

name: XS Baggage
description: An exploration of baggage, both physical and emotional, and their place in each individual's personal journey. With a blend of whimsey and nostalgia, XS Baggage invites inspection and introspection. A visual representation of the C.S. Lewis quote,"It's not he load that breaks you down, it's how you carry it."
artist: XS Baggage by Paul Lucas and team

name: Scrubby
description: Black Rock City's Cleanest Art Car.

name: The Intergalactic Transporter
description: Hop on the IGT for transportation to the next galaxy!
artist: The Intergalactic Transporter by Chico Urban Area

name: Azeban - The Trash Panda
description: Azeban the Trash Panda is a raccoon art car, lighting up the night and seeking out the people, places and mischief which make Burning Man so unique.
artist: The Trash Panda by the Black Rock Bandits

name: Moby- The Rainbow Fish
description: A vibrant, LED-lit mutant vehicle shaped like a rainbow fish, with glowing scales and whimsical, flowing fins, creating a mesmerizing, colorful spectacle embodying the principles of generosity, connection, and celebration of uniqueness.
artist: Cassandra Caron, James Trebesch & the Ocean Crew

name: Whipple 3
description: The Calico Dragon is one of the most approachable cars on playa.  With long couches lining both sides of the vehicle and a single step up to sit down makes this vehicle less intimidating for burners to hop on and enjoy the ride.

name: Third Eye Scream
description: The iconic Third Eye Scream is play on the Illuminati, and a symbol of enlightenment.  You can find it parked somewhere gifting ice cream or floating on the horizon playing mystical tunes in Deep Playa at night.

name: Disco Hauler
description: The Disco Crew and its helpers will spread joy and cheer to the Burners and dancers around the playa and give thanks and appreciation to the best week of my life.

name: Tauntaun
description: A floating Tauntaun travels across the desert carrying a crusty burner.  Whom tamed whom?

name: MooMooMobile
description: Sir Loin the MooMooMobile is a cute cow. Come ring our cowbells!
artist: MooMooMobile by Angela Chang & Ed Liao

name: SS Mezcal
description: SS Mezcal is a solar powered electric mutant vehicle styled as a fractured mezcal barrel from the future. The SS stands for spaceship, a tongue in cheek nod to a craft that cruises the dust instead of the space. Built as a moving gift rather than a private party, it rolls up to create quick moments with strangers: a toast, a short dance, a tiny ritual, or a good story. The crew actively hosts and keeps it welcoming. Spot us on playa, flag us down and jump aboard!
artist: SS Mezcal by Rubber Armstrong Crew

name: Blue Bull
description:
"Blue Bull" is a mutant vehicle inspired by Maria Prymachenko's 1947 artwork of the same name, transforming Ukrainian folk art into a bold, mobile presence on the playa.
Covered in plush, UV-reactive blue fur, this monumental creature glows at night and moves through Black Rock City with immersive sound and dynamic lighting. Sunset and select evening DJ sets activate it as a vibrant yet welcoming gathering space.
More than a sound vehicle, Blue Bull is a roaming cultural statement — a living interpretation of Ukrainian artistic heritage, reimagined as a surreal, participatory environment where people meet, dance, and share in a collective moment of creativity.

name: Fins of fortune
description:
Fins of Fortune is a koi-inspired art cart embodying the ancient legend of transformation through art, food, light, and performance. This steampunk-sculpted koi glows with animated LED scales that pulse in rhythm, telling the story of the fish who swam upstream, leapt the Dragon Gate, and became a dragon.

This is not a rideable vehicle, but a roaming immersive installation designed to spark joy and interaction. At its heart is a taiyaki station gifting koi-shaped treats and milk teas. Whimsical aviator fish-fin characters and interactive performers animate the space with playful movement and storytelling rooted in Asian symbolism.

name: The Monkey
description: The Monkey was created for cruises on the playa, easy accessibility for all burners to jump on and enjoy the art and beauty that Burning Man provides each year.

name: HunDroid
description: Hungarian assisted self driving Mooncar
artist: HunDroid Art Car by the Palinka Lounge Crew

name: Glorb the beignet max pro 2 too
description: Glorb is a fully electric remote controlled art car designed to showcase the transition to an all electric sustainable future.  Don't try to listen or smell for Glorb's approach, because Glorb is silent with a delightful lack of gasoline fumes that are common on so many art cars.  Your ears and nose are no good here.  To find Glorb, you must use your eyes or your heart.  Look for a bright glowing cube at night, a holographic rainbow cube during the day, and follow the feeling of the vibes of love and friendship in your heart.
artist: Glorb The Beignet Max Pro 2 too by The Glorb Crew

name: Discohover and Discolounge
description: Discohover and Discolounge is the Future Retro Playground for your Playa Alteration Fun.  Discohover the Playa, Lounge at your favorite Disco.
artist: Discohover,  by the Playa Alterations Crew

name: SM Cascabel
description: Cascabel is a trajinera - the iconic flower-covered gondolas of Xochimilco, Mexico City - reimagined as an electric art car. Built by LaCalaca Village, a camp with over a decade on playa and creators of the Axolotl art car, Cascabel carries the living cultural tradition of Mexico's ancient waterways to the desert. Thirteen feet of hand-painted baroque arch, cushioned lounge seating, and a sound system pointed inward for intimate cruising. Different nights, different names scrawled in chalk on the arch — each voyage a small floating world. Come find us. Hop on. No invitation needed.

name: The Great Sammich Ride
description:
Are you hungry? I'm your hot cinnamon-butter joy injection.
Actually, I'm a giant, squishy peanut butter and jelly Sammich with wings. You can eat me! You can dance with me! You can hitch a ride on my cushy peanut-butter wings!
I'm here to deliver joy on the playa by serving hot 'n toasty cinnamon-butter grilled, gluten-free gourmet PB&J's.
Look for my rotating "Sammiches" marquee sign and hop on board for a loungy ride around the ol' dust bowl at exactly Whenever O'clock.  And if you really want fun, join my Sammich crew in serving up hot toasty delights to other hungry burners today.
Because as my Grandma Sammich once told me:
"There's no holier act than helping others get the goody out of life."
Come play!
- The Great Sammich Ride

name: Schwangline Stapler
description: Red Schwangline Stapler Dance Machine

name: The Dancing Peacock
description: The Dancing Peacock spreading love, and offering rides to all on the playa.
artist: The Dancing Peacock by Roger Stinson

name: Wanda
description: Known as Wanda, this mutant vehicle wonderful highly articulated creation of the rarely seen deep sea creature known as Angler Fish. Day or night, the vehicle is highly visible and easily recognizable as same to those who have seen pictures of this illusive creature.

name: Forest House
description: The Forest House Art Car is a two-story mobile art piece featuring 30,000 LEDs and a Void Acoustics sound system. It offers an immersive experience with vibrant lighting and powerful audio, creating a dynamic space for exploration, music, and creative expression.
artist: Forest House by the Forest House Art Crew

name: La Rana Hypnótica
description: A hypnotic and colorful frog who glides around the Playa offering rides to dusty burners. You'll be mesmerized by his changing colors and dapper appearance.

name: Chelonix Art Car
description: Chelonix is a giant glowing space turtle roaming the playa. Built on a box truck platform, the vehicle features a wooden turtle shell structure, an animatronic head, inflatable flippers, and a central dance floor where participants can gather, climb, and explore. Flowing fabrics conceal the truck beneath and evoke an underwater kelp forest moving through the desert wind. By day, Chelonix appears as a playful ocean creature crossing the dust. By night, thousands of LEDs transform it into a luminous cosmic turtle swimming through Black Rock City.
artist: Chelonix Art Car by the fireborntools crew

name: Magnolia Thunderpussy
description: Magnolia Thunderpussy, the mutant vehicle is a copper colored 21 foot Pangolin, based on an endangered species from Africa and China. She is made from over 800 hand cut steel scales.
artist: Magnolia Thunderpussy by Jennifer Cull Artist

name: Disco Roboto Iron GIant
description: Disco Roboto Iron Giant is a playa people mover, inspiring dance, laughter, lights, flames, and community.
artist: Iron Giant by Lewbel and Disco Roboto Crew

name: Sparky the Star Trek Shuttlecraft
description: its a ford aerostar van taken down to its floorboards and rebuilt as a shuttlecraft from startek

name: A Streetcar Named DESIRE
description:
A Streetcar Named Desire. Transport vehicle with authentic Streetcar roof system. Design includes handicap access
and wheelchair access (2). Can accommodate 16(+)(-) comfortably.
artist: A Streetcar named DESIRE, multiple contributors

name: Helios
description: Helios serves as a reminder of what it means to be human. In this age of technology, we need to keep our connection with nature. Life is beautiful.

name: Dream Genie
description: A magical traveling genie bottle

name: Sweet Car Bed
description: Sweet Car Bed, by Andy Henry.
artist: Sweet Car Bed by Andy Henry

name: Dust-e
description: After WALL-E cleaned up all the MOOP on Earth for humanity, he decided to head to Burning Man with his Playa name "DUST-E". His new directive will be clearing MOOP in the  Black Rock City with his cute appearance and innocent demeanor. He's looking forward to interfacing and shaking his can at Robot Heart.
artist: Dust-e with his BNL crew, Spanky and Jewalia.

name: Vroom Vroom
description: Vroom Vroom is a giant Roller Skate that's a tribute and homage to roller skaters around the world. I've been skating for 14 years and love the community of skaters I've met.
artist: Ivizia Dakini, Adam Goldthwaite, Blake Hicks

name: Clown Car
description: Clown Car is a small cart size vehicle with a giant yellow happy face in front and a giant red clown bowler on top.  The custom widened, low profile looking  metal body has a fire truck feel.  The custom upholstery adds a lot of great colors to the R G B L LED lighting system,

name: Mush: The Magic Myco Mobile
description: This magical field of mushrooms lofts above its turtle's back waiting to shade you and take you on a trip to see the wonders the burn has to offer.
artist: Mush: The Magic Myco Mobile's Art Car Crew

name: Dust Slug
description: Dust Slug is a prehistoric beast reincarnated from the dust of the dry Lahontan lakebed that is now called Black Rock Desert. With dazzling nighttime color displays and tentacles blowing in the wind it entrances BRC citizens to join it in its endless wandering.
artist: Dust Slug by the Dust Slug Den

name: Favela Culture
description: The Favela Culture Mutant Vehicle is characterized by its skull-shaped design, symbolizing the universal truth that we are all equal beneath the surface. Regardless of differences in skin color, religion, sexual orientation or economic status, we are all united as human beings. Join us to dance and experience the vibrant culture of Brazil, brought to life and shared with the community of Black Rock City!
artist: Favela Cultute by Art Marinho, Joinha & Esquerda

name: Vessel of Love
description:
The Vessel of Love is a glowing mobile lounge designed to spread connection and joy across the playa. 
Built from a mutated electric golf buggy, it features a cozy cuddle puddle for passengers to relax together and a small viewing deck above for taking in the magic of Black Rock City. 
Inspired by our Vessels of Love art installation and its infinity heart theme, the vehicle travels the playa sharing warmth, music, and spontaneous moments of togetherness. With vibrant LED lighting and a welcoming atmosphere, the Vessel of Love invites burners to pause, connect, and experience a little more love on the journey.

name: RocketCar
description: The Rocket Car is a handmade desert rocket built from salvaged machines and aircraft parts. Its body began as a surplus aircraft drop tank that was reshaped into a narrow aluminum fuselage. Powered by a Honda CX500 motorcycle engine and rolling on rescued MG axles, it looks like a strange experimental rocket cruising the playa. The Rocket Car roams Black Rock City and deep playa offering spontaneous rides and photo moments to curious travelers. By day it looks like a scrap built test vehicle from another era, and by night its glowing lights make it appear like a small wandering rocket exploring the desert.

name: Gema
description: Be not afraid

name: Shiny
description: Shining

name: Humble Be
description:
To build our art car we decided to use a recycled, crashed, fully electric Nissan Leaf as the base car. We have striped
apart the car, leaving the interior half, motor, battery system, and other elements necessary to leave the art car
operational and high voltage safe and secure to drive on the Playa. 
The "sculpture" have been elevated and braced six feet over the platform with vertical supports
enough to stabilize the piece during its ride and to possible high winds/storms at the Playa.
The platform and the sculpture is well-illuminated with yellow/orange/gold LED lights in different shapes.
We have 3 low-pressure steady flames (one in each antenna and a third one in the sting) fueled by propane tanks
placed inside the platform.
artist: Humble Be art car by Uncle J and Humble Be crew

name: Giving Tree
description: The Giving Tree art car brings a unique one of a kind immersive experience to the imagination of creation. She's a willow tree that stands 25 feet tall, 28 feet long, 24 feet wide. Her trunks base is 21 feet long, 8 feet wide. It's a unmutilated 1989 Blue Bird short bus tiny home that hides inside her trunk which makes for a very grounded mobile or stationary tree house on wheels. You can ascend up a 6 foot tree ladder through a hatch door that lets you access the upper rooftop party deck. In the center of the rooftop the trunk continues up with a 5 foot tree ladder to a crows nest also with safety railings. From the crows nest just under the top canopy of willow branches the views of any event are spectacular.
artist: Giving Tree art car by Adam DeDecker

name: Pyramix
description: 30 ft wide , 30 ft tall, three level, three-sided Pyramid car
artist: Pyramix  designed and built by Douglas Bosworth

name: GoCaBo
description: A land lubbin' Playa Boat

name: The Surly Bird
description:
The Surly Bird is the double decker art car of Surly Camp. She first debuted on the playa in 2003 and has undergone some amazing and imaginative transformations since then. As the DMV and Burning Man community are demanding higher quality art and ingenuity, the crew of Surly Camp rises to the occasion, offering the eyes new and inspiring imagery. 2012 brought forth the Surly Phoenix, with laser eyes and feathers galore. Lots of hard work went into this baby, and the DMV seemed happy enough... 

The crew of Surly Camp steps up each year in a big way to give the old girl a fresh coat of love. They drive and fly in from all over the states to help out in the months before Burning Man. They do it out of love. They do it for you.
artist: The Surly Bird and Surly Camp

name: Serenity
description: Serenity started out in the back yard of an antique store. She was a WW2 drop tank that was attached to military planes. She was used to drop flares, paper leaflets with warnings and supplies from her belly. When I found her she was filled with leaves from a few decades ago. I had to have her, I had to give her a new life of gifting to others. She can now give a ride to those in need or a drink to those who are thirsty or she can simply be seen in her beauty as burners stand back and admire her mutated sprit, sole, and transformation. Everything about her had a different life. She is made from salvaged recycled parts, from school chairs to a bone yard of crashed, given up ATV's and speakers covered in dust in a corner of a pawn shop.

name: Horse
description: Horse was adopted from the BLM pens in Spanish Springs, Nevada.  She has returned to her homeland range in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. A gentle soul she is, but she can also buck the most robust of cowboys.  Horse is typically happy to help weary travelers to their destination. She can often be found checking the fencelines at BRC, and is always looking for fellow horses to gallop across the range with.

name: Steampunk Weighted Companion Cube
description:
The Aperture Science Enrichment Center reminds you that the Weighted Companion Cube will never threaten to stab you and, in fact, cannot speak. However, any advice it does give you should be radically included.

The Weighted Companion Cubes are from the computer game "Portal"; this year there will be two, one companion cube and one steampunk cube. They are single rider, mobile art pieces, a 3 foot square cube, with sound and lights.

Remember, the cake is a lie!

name: REDEMPTION
description:
We started out with a zero turn Kubota lawnmower and eliminated everything but the drivetrain and motor. 

We named her Redemption because she started out as a lawnmower 20 years ago, slaving away and working hard. She is redeeming herself in a way to be shared amongst all Burners; for those that want to climb in for a picture, simply want to enjoy the ride, or to assist them in getting from one place to another. Redemption will provide a unique experience that our camp and others can enjoy.

name: I Think I Can
description: I Think I Can - tugboat—a whimsical vessel cruising the playa, complete with nautical details and fun crew onboard!
artist: I Think I Can by Marko K.

name: Flux Capacitor
description: Only stupid people would attempt to build a car like this. Or really dumb people. One of the two.

name: Petabyte
description: Consisting of over a million fiber optics and contributions from many of our brilliantly talented friends, Petabyte is BYTE's most collaborative and extraordinary expression of light, sound and tactility yet!

name: Thong patrol
description:
The thong patrol!
A multi-purpose art car designed to look like a flip flop and feel like your at the beach. A 100% electric art car designed to make a small footprint on a big beach. A functional art car/service vehicle loaded with tools to fix anything anywhere!

name: Hsssisss - the Baby Sea Dragon
description: Hssiss - the Baby Sea serpent Dragon is the love child of Abraxas the golden dragon that has been roaming the playa since 2006. She is a zippy little dragon that loves to roam the outer playa finding play mates to pick up and go on adventures with. She loves good music and sunrises and long drives on the playa. she is a shinny beautiful creature that comes when called and  will do tricks for love. She tends to stick close to her mum (when her mum is in fine form) and likes to cast shade and bring beverages and snacks to the wandering folk of black rock city.

name: The Underneath
description: The Underneath is a glowing decomposer-on-wheels, where personal and planetary composting become one regenerative act.
artist: Rachel Zucker and Shlomo Zippel and Sean Stillwell

name: Iron Butterfly
description: A giant butterfly of bright fabric and aluminum. During the day, an oasis with lots of shade and cold beverages. At night, chill and dreamy rides.
artist: Iron Butterfly by Bobby Stimmler Johnson

name: Jolly the incredibly annouying chimp II
description: The creepy chimp clapping cymbals we have all grown to Love or Hate that is always on playa.

name: Dakini Hathini
description: A neon-pink fuzzy elephant glowing like cotton candy under the Black Rock sky. LED eyes twinkling, trunk swaying to the beat—pure playa magic on four fuzzy legs. Hop on and ride the chaos!
artist: Happy Hanuman ; Happy Hanuman MV Crew

name: Zeong
description: "Witness the awe-inspiring Pui, evolved from a loyal sidekick into a colossal Gundam mech, dominating the Playa with style! Clad in shimmering armor, its thrusters roar like a desert storm, leaving trails of stardust in its wake. Armed with laser precision and an adorable battle stance, this mech-master patrols the wild sands, a perfect blend of cuddly charm and unstoppable might—ready to protect the Playa from any intergalactic mischief!"
artist: Happy Hanuman ; Happy Hanuman MV Crew

name: Soulshakers Photo Serpent
description: Capture the moment on the Playa in our Interactive Photo Bus Serpent Hop in, strike a pose, and let the Soulshakers Photo Serpent  give you a memory to cherish long after you leave the Black Rock City.
artist: Photo Serpent By: Camp Soulshakers Art Team

name: Jelly Fish Hexacycle
description: A jelly fish shaped, 6-wheeled, pedal and electric powered vehicle that can transport people above, and temporarily engulf walkers and bikers below, bathing them with its mesmerizing tentacles & cooling mist!
artist: Jelly Fish Hexacycle by OliverLights & CampGravity

name: Serendeep
description: Embark on an odyssey across the playa aboard Serendeep, a mystical steampunk carriage - a place where old and new friends join together to journey through the desert sparking wonder, curiosity, and camaraderie.
artist: Serendeep Wagon by Haba and Crew

name: Garden of Dreamin'
description: The Garden of Dreamin' is a lush, otherworldly escape where reality bends and imagination blooms. Winding paths lead through surreal landscapes of lava flows, whispering fungi, and glowing plants that sway with the breeze. It's a sanctuary for wanderers, lovers, and late-night thinkers.  Hop on and find yourself in a place where time slows, stars feel closer, and dreams drift freely among the alien trees.

name: The Cloud
description: The Cloud is a group project by a bunch of crazy tree people who like bright music and loud lights :)-

name: Sound Garden
description: Sound Garden is a whimsical and vibrant, lighted grass hill, blooming with flowers, cruising through the day and night, enveloping riders and onlookers in soundscapes and chill beats as they relax in comfort on the fluffy grass.
artist: Sound Garden Art Car by the Soundgarden Crew

name: Dreamtime MV
description: Dreamtime encourages and inspires us to unwind, unlock, and let our minds run free with imagination and curiosity. An island of calm in deep playa and beyond, find us and dream together.

name: Cash Only
description: A life size version of an operational closed circuit camera from the 1980s era capturing all the dusty Roving Voyeurism of BRC brought to you by BRCCTV. Only to be broadcast on the sides of the vehicle with an dLED matrix
artist: Cash Only, James Trebesch, Moon Landing

name: Eitherlight
description: Eitherlight emerges and merges from the past and the future together, offering a place of celebration and relaxation for weary playa wanderers. Come to Eitherlight to receive and reprieve everything you've wanted and then some. If you're cooked and cold, we will whip you up some cocoa. We cookin' yo!
artist: Eitherlight by HK Artz and the Sicara Squad

name: Monaco
description: A square rigged 1/2 scale replica frigate ship that actually sails under wind power whenever possible, the world’s largest landsailer, and we are not pirates…

name: Pink Aditi
description: The Pink Aditi is an old styled buggy, like the one Dracula used to transport his coffin, but this one, was hit with the wand of an excitable fairy princess. With pink LED net curtains floating hundreds of pink LEDs behind the driver, pink fur seats, lots of pillows and blankets in the lounge-tub, offset by the clean hard lines of the raw steel Madd Max body. She's meant to inspire joy, wonder, to make a bubble of theater in the midst of all the spectacle. Sexy, stylish and silly all at the same time. It looks like a cartoon. It is plush and soft up front. It is lit up wildly with lights of all sorts, and the flaming flowers have a poofer to excite fire enthusiasts everywhere.

name: Playa Trolly / Fun House
description: Experience the Playa Trolley / Fun House, a mobile party with a stunning display of lights and music that will immerse you in the heart of Burning Man. Whether inside or outside, this rolling work of art will keep you entertained as the Playa comes alive around you.

name: La Catrina
description: La Catrina represents a Mexican holiday tradition that is celebrated on Nov 1and Nov 2, on these days we remember and honor our deceased loved ones, it is believe that their spirit returns and visits their families. Families build ofrendas {altars} with marigolds, candles, photos and food to guide their spirits.
artist: La Catrina by Art Artists Jonathan and Sonya

name: Tuatara
description: Tuatara are reptiles endemic to New Zealand. Although resembling most lizards, they are more dinosaur than lizard. Their name derives from the Māori language, and means "peaks on the back"
artist: Charlie Hand - Artist / Jason Baratta - Handler

name: Regal Eagle
description: Built by artists Garry Sutherland, Shawn Lusebrink, and Rachael Buselmeier. Our majestic and noble art deco eagle, was created using the English wheel technique. The artists are a seasoned team of mutant vehicle builders. They have contributed to the Burning Man experience for decades. The Regal Eagle is a true gift to Black Rock City for 2026.
artist: Regal Eagle by Sutherland Team & Metal Mimi Camp

name: Great Sax
description: Great Sax is an artist's representation (NOT an exact depiction) of a large scale mobile Saxophone from a concept by professional Saxman, Rick Metz (Navigator RICK). It's equipped with a small, high quality sound system for playing recorded and live music. It's radically illuminated so that it's highly visible at night. It made its debut at BM 2023.
artist: Great Sax by Navigator RICK built by Jeff Rocke

name: NumbSkull
description: Uncle Sam skull car with rainbow led lights.

name: Quesadilla Armadilla
description: The Quesadilla Armadilla celebrates life with love of stories and food, the way my dad did. We remember him with this piece and remind everyone with whom we interact, to be present in this moment and enjoy it with the people you are with. This moment will soon be gone, but another will appear. Savor the moments you are fortunate enough to share with those you love.

name: Boy Lady Bug
description: Come take a ride across the playa in The Boy Lady Bug!
artist: Boy Lady Bug by Kevin Clark

name: Snow Patrol
description: A DEEP-playa après-ski lounge. Snow Patrol is swapping the slopes in the Sierras for the dust in BRC to bring you cabin-cozy vibes, and frosty beats. No lift ticket required—just climb aboard, hop on a chair, and aprés all day and night!🎿❄️
artist: owned by Stevie and Sammi Devencenzi

name: Hanuman Ji
description: A pentagonal prism art car with parametric face panels of the five faced form of Hanuman (Panchamukhi Hanuman). The "crown" panels on top are CNC cut panels in design stylings of Hindu deity crowns.

name: Copper Top
description: Copper Top was built by artist Shawn Lusebrink (Pacific Renn) out of everyday objects. Everything from a dog dish to concrete tubes has gone into making this one of a kind piece.

name: Abraxas
description:
Abraxas Dragon has been on playa since 2006, providing incredible music, art and vibes. 

Abraxas is partnered with the Non-Profit Grassroots Aid Partnership and assists with Disaster Relief, notably for Hurricane Helene in North Carolina as well as Moonlight Orphanage in Uganda, Africa. 

Abraxas has participated in ground-breaking events such as: Catharsis on the Mall in D.C., and M.A.P.S Psychedelic Conference in Denver.

Abraxas has a history of being one of the most recognizable and photogenic art cars on the playa.
artist: Tim Clark and the Abraxas Dragon Team

name: Taking Back The Tea Party
description: The Tea Party, Cheshire Cat and Caterpillar from Alice in Wonderland
artist: Taking Back the Tea Party by Louis Ceci

name: One-Eyed Monster Art Car
description: The One-Eyed Monster Art Car (OEM) is a vision, as with the design and builder of Stone Larkin. His vision of the One-Eyed Monster is the male creative force seeking a place to plant, inseminate, and create. The One-Eyed Monster Car is a physical manifestation of this energy. One that has manifested itself on the playa since 2013, and with each passing year, this manifestation only grows stronger! Since 2019, a new team has learned to tame the OEM.
artist: Stone Larkin Artist / Owners OEM Art Car Crew

name: Dukduk
description: The DukDuk covered wagon designed by Ivy Waegel and Calli Beck

name: LifeCar
description: LifeCar is a scaled version of the 1964 game piece from The Game of Life built by Shawn Lusebrink and Gary Sutherland.
artist: Shawn Lusebrink and Gary Sutherland (Pacific Renn)

name: Playacuda
description: Playacuda is a socially immersive, friendly fish ready to have you join in the fun as we drive around the playa.

name: Gothic Dust
description: The Gothic Carriage is a custom-built electric art vehicle designed to resemble a moving gothic architectural structure rather than a conventional car. Its tall silhouette, dark exterior finish, and sculptural details such as gargoyles and ornamental trim create the visual presence of a gliding carriage across the playa. The enclosed cabin accommodates up to four passengers, offering an intimate and immersive environment for shared interaction. Exterior profile lighting defines the vehicle's shape at night, enhancing visibility while preserving its dramatic outline. Designed for stable movement across soft terrain, the carriage functions both as a transport platform and a mobile interactive art installation for participant engagement.

name: Sparkle Trike
description: Sparkle Trike is an alien biker creation designed to look like a disembodied glowing head float across the playa
artist: Sparkle Trike by Sparkles inspired by Fuser

name: Sound Bite
description: A glowing, winged angler fish inspired by steampunk and fantasy, featuring vibrant LED panels, immersive sound, and a cozy ride space.

name: The Metro Chop
description: An Art Car for the people.  Where everyone is VIP and we aim to save the world one burner at a time.
artist: The Metro Chop,  on going project by the crew

name: Kissy Fish
description: A sparkling, walking fish covered with holographic scales with giant moving red lips, big kinetic legs that crawling along the playa, and pairs of waving fins and tails

name: Classic Slide
description: The Classic Slide is a circus tent you can climb and slide down from the top of

name: Dirty Dinghy
description: The Dirty Dinghy is a tiny, untrustworthy boat strapped to an electric tricycle, drifting across the dusty seas of Black Rock City in search of shady moments, smooth rides, and chapped lips to save. Built for absurd adventures and sunscreen gifting, this playa dinghy is captained by questionable intentions and fueled by bad ideas (electric bad ideas). Hop aboard if you're lost, sunburnt, or just looking for trouble—no lifejacket required.

name: Tikivision
description:
TikiVision is a Large Mobile Retro Television-Shaped Vehicle and Interactive Media Lounge, providing entertainment,
comfort, tours, and services for denizens of Black Rock City.

name: Sil-vi
artist: Sil-Vi Marco Cochran and the Bojon Team

name: Relaxolotl
description: Looking for a chill way to explore playa? Climb aboard Relaxolotl, where you'll find a cozy place to sit (both because of the cushions and due to its small size ;)), good conversation, a choice of chill tunes, and a slightly faster-than-walking speed to enjoy the city at a slower pace.

name: TRION
description:
A moving temple of light and sound, based on sacred geometry and designed as a musical stage. At its core is the triangle — the fundamental form of the structure and a central symbol in sacred geometry, representing balance, ascension, and connection.

It creates an immersive experience through music, light, and collective energy, bringing people together and uniting them through sound in a shared moment in the desert.

Blending ancient symbolic ideas with modern technology, it becomes more than an art car — a luminous triangular form moving through the night, creating moments of energy, connection, and collective experience.

name: The Bounce Car
description: Party Machine spreading Bouncy vibes all over the Playa...

name: Kinderpanzer
description: Kinderpanzer is an apocalypse inspired armored tank paying tribute to the early days of Burning Man before Black Rock City had streets. The shell is made of entirely recycled aluminum and steel, built in 2017 by the K-Rats. Project lead artist & fabrication: Lynn Bryant, design & detailing: Kimric Smythe & Walter Petelle (K-Rats)

name: The Millennium  Falcon
description: Han's iconic smuggling ship, The Millennium Falcon lives on.  Reimagined on a Nascar Frame wrapped in steel.  Built to scale and powered by a Second Gen Chevy v-8 small block it is still one of the fastest hunks of junk in the Galaxy.

name: Dandy Lion
description: The Dandy Lion Bus is a 22 foot bus with a raised platform on top that has lots of space for hanging out and enjoying some music and good views.  We want to be adventurers and take friends to as many sites as we can.  During the day the Dandy Lion participates in the area transit program to offer rides to as many people as we can.  Our krewe started a friends and volunteers at Reggae on the River and Reggae Rising and brought our camp spirit and family to Burning Man to continue our legacy.  We are devoted to inclusion and love to hear people say that they are having their first ride on a mutant vehicle when they come aboard.
artist: The Dandy Lion by Slim, Hooter, Mikey and friends

name: Excite Trike
description: The Excite Trike is a unique and eccentric looking trike with 7-foot diameter wheels fun banners and loads of LEDs that is guaranteed to bring both smiles and long stares during the day and at night time.

name: Bugaboo 2
description: Bugaboo2 ( soon to be renamed) is a fun monster mutant vehicle that will make you smile and laugh

name: Space Shuttle
description: Rock it ! Man Is a unique space shuttle that cruises Playa sharing laughs and wifi.
artist: Space Shuttle by Space Fairing Humans

name: Savage island
description: Massive island with a local bar in the jungle vide

name: Raclette One
description:
The Raclette One is a Swiss-Themed Spacecraft

As we all know - Switzerland is famous for cheese. What is mostly unknown is that Swiss cheese is harvested on the Moon by Astronaut Farmers. This year - we will bring our flagship - The Raclette one - to the playa. Our goal is to educate people about the origin of cheese and give out cheesy samples to dusty travelers.
artist: The Raclette One by The Swiss Space Bar Crew

name: Byrdhaüs
description: Fly away with the majestic mountain blue bird across the desert, rest in its home or under the wings for some shade during the days, and enjoy its musical calls and vibrant lights through the night.

name: Immortal
description: Immortal is a glowing jellyfish art car, built in honor and to highlight the resilience and rebirth of the remarkable Turritopsis dohrnii (immortal jellyfish).

name: Jeffrey the Furry Helicopter
description: The Jeffrey is the fun fuzzy and furry Helicopter

name: POLARIS
description: Polaris is the North Star, the guiding star that takes you to your destination. And then... brings you back home - back to Playa.

name: The Galactic Terrapin
description: The Galactic Terrapin, aka “Bustachio”, is our beloved sea turtle. Based on a 1987 Ford 460 bus, he hosts a dj booth and dance floor atop his 30-person deck. The Galactic Terrapin glides across the playa aiming to take you on your next intergalactic adventure of epic proportions. Rear-end entry only, please.
artist: The Galactic Terrapin by Brandi Lakey and the GTC

name: Don't Panic
description:
Deep Thought is a colossal supercomputer and spaceship mutant vehicle inspired by The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. From the outside it appears as a towering robot with a head of giant glowing screens, powered by a neon-lit city.
We built it as a playful, sarcastic reflection on humanity's growing reliance on AI. While the 2026 theme Axis Mundi explores the natural cosmic axis of existence, Deep Thought humorously asks whether artificial intelligence can compute the Ultimate Answer to Life, the Universe, and Everything.
Inside the darkened starship, plush couches await travelers for an immersive interstellar journey. Climb aboard, contribute your thoughts, and hitch a ride. We hope to deliver the Answer before the week ends.
artist: Deep Thought by Sergey Nahodi and Dreamery Crew

name: Fertility Bed 10.1
description: Its a Motorized Bed, very soft and fun
artist: FERTILITY BED 11.0  By RIC and Crew

name: vibeapple
description: The Vibiest Pineapple on earth

name: BumpBed
description: Bumping double decker 2 story vibrant bright glowing mobile and sound mutant vehicle with DJ booth and dance floor, hand painted art, funky faux fur interior and thousands of LEDs .

name: The Perambulator
description: The Perambulator is a splendid steampunk airship with seating for 8 passengers and a rear cargo deck for wheelchairs/mobility scooters.

name: Starship Qubit
description: The Overview Effect is in effect! Program the hyperdrive and explore the solar system. Come see the Earth and the stars and many things beyond. Aliens are welcome!

name: Tracks
description:
I started out with a two older snowblowers, eliminated everything but one of the motors, and replaced the drivetrain and reoriented the motor to accommodate a new, customer drive linkage assembly.

I named her Tracks because she started out as two old snowblowers having tank track style wheels, slaving away and working hard. Now those tracks have been repurposed to be shared among all Burners and the Burning Man community, for those that want to climb on for a ride or a picture. Tracks will provide a unique experience that our camp and others can enjoy.

name: The Tea Kettle
description: a vibrant tea kettle and tea cup with 360 viewing, offering water and shade to all!

name: Bass Snail
description: The Bass Snail transforms a classic chassis into a glowing, prehistoric wonder. With a custom wood frame, a massive PVC shell, and a sculptural mushroom roof, this creature serves as a beacon of wonder in the deep playa night. Beyond aesthetics, the Bass Snail is a gift of mobility. Rooted in Radical Inclusion, we prioritize gifting rides to those with ADA needs. We invite you to climb aboard our low-entry foot, find a seat under the mushroom, and enjoy a magical, inclusive journey home.
artist: Bass Snail by Nick Navarro and Camp Acid Drip

name: Slava Oksani Sunflower (SOS)
description: The Slava Oksani Sunflower (SOS) is the yellow fluffy incandescent aquatic wonderland of our dreams. This year MARION JR joins the spectacularity!
artist: Slava Oksana Sunflower by The ADHDAF Collective

name: X-34 Landspeeder
description: The X-34 Landspeeder is an open-air cockpit speeder powered a repulsorlift engine and three air-cooled thrust turbines. It hovers three feet off the ground and is ideal transportation for open desert environments. This model is bright red and gold and can be found most days at Black Rock City in the Mos Eisley Spaceport camp.
artist: X-34 Landspeeder by Erik and Liam Hadley

name: Flash Gordon Rocket Ship
description: For those old enough to remember the Flash Gordon TV series, This is a replica of the Rocket Ship.
artist: Flash Gordon Rocket Ship by Sharkey

name: This Is Fine
description: The world might be a rolling dumpster fire in the desert, but according to ancient wisdom that's also where the strongest steel is forged. Remember, just because you’re trash doesn’t mean you can’t do great things. It’s called garbage can, not garbage cannot!

name: Kwalq Bus (formerly known as Thataway Bus)
description: The Kwalq Bus is here to transform your experience, pointing the way with a simple, giant, neon frog directing you to new adventures.

name: Chi11er
description: Chi11er is a 15' tall mobile tower that delivers ice cream to Deep Playa, look us up!

name: L'Atelier de Wagon
description: L'Atelier de Wagon has been created solely for the intent of interaction, participation, leave no trace, and gifting at Burning Man.The vehicle is a mobile art studio, bringing together professional and amateur artists or anyone whom wants to give painting a shot. Atelier gives the ability to participants to share their feelings, emotions, thoughts, and minds through live, group, artwork creation. Participants can paint in one location, load into the vehicle, be comfortable during a journey, then unload and continue to work in a new location creating a whole new set of outside interaction in which to paint.
artist: L'Atelier de Wagon, by Gary Geske and Marc Fabbri

name: Stargazer
description: 40ft labyrinth triple level dragon LED bus wth fire effects

name: Playa Piano Bar and Airport Shuttle
description: Dueling piano bar and lounge that travels 8 feet above the playa, but stops for performances rising 20 ft above the playa with live music!

name: Ray
description: Ray, the Friendly aluminum skinned cart sized Manta Ray

name: Black Rock Bomber
description: Silver cart sized Black Rock Bomber
artist: Black Rock Bomber by Sid Kurtz

name: The Disco Ball
description: An amazing, shiny Disco Ball art car spreading love, music and fun one ride at a time.
artist: The Disco Ball car by James DiGiorgio and Cornelia

name: Secret Weapon
description: miniature locomotive on a pocket bike

name: Eyezekiel
description: A biblically accurate angel with wings, rings, and googly eyes.

name: Son of Hal
description: Lazyboy Lounge Chair

name: Edna The Elephant
description: A fire breathing, laser cut, stainless steel and wood combination providing interactivity and baselines for the Playa

name: Cloudius
description: Taylor Dunn vehicle mutated into a steel armature in the shape of an Angel Wings over the clouds with a built-in cotton-candy maker Up in the front Covered with Crown wings Mask.

name: Beautiful Engine
description: Beautiful Engine is a small Moroccan style palanquin-like mutant vehicle, designed to transport burners in a comfy, fuzzy bed. Originally part of a fleet, has gained its own unique character with some extra mutations by the new owners (since 2017).
artist: Beautiful Engine by the Beautiful Engine Crew

name: Candyland Car
description: All aboard the Candyland Car! We're on our way to Willy Wonka's factory to raid his stockpiles and create some mischief with the Umpa Lumpas!

name: Gypsy Kitty
description: Gypsy Playa Raver Kitty is our Green mythical magical playa kitty that is out spreading love and rainbow colored magic.
artist: Gypsy Kitty by  Rave Dave and Kitty Crew

name: SUPERFLY
description: The SUPERFLY is a 65' long house fly, an assemblage of reclaimed carhoods, blind spot mirrors and crumbled window screen, all brought together for the inclusive transit service of BRC

name: Lepi Duo
description: A larger than life Butterfly that 4 people can ride on the back of while cruising the playa.

name: Disorient Express
description: The last train out of everywhere, heading somewhere new. Born from the rusted rail yards of Europe and pointed vaguely at outer space, the Disorient Express runs no fixed schedule and stops wherever it feels right. Climb aboard, find a seat, meet your fellow passengers. The destination is unknown but the ride is the point.
artist: Disorient Express by Endstation x Wanderzirkus

name: Grit and Gold
description: Grit and Gold is an electric art car inspired by a traditional Hong Kong junk boat, reimagined for the playa. Designed to embody resilience, creativity, and connection, it offers a mobile gathering space for friends and fellow burners. At night, blue underglow lights mimic movement over water, while RGB lighting, mandalas, and UV-reactive artwork bring it to life. A built-in sound system sets the vibe, and the crew serves cold chai and matcha to spark moments of joy. In the spirit of Tomorrow Today, Grit and Gold invites the community to dream, dance, and build the future together.

name: Matsya
description: Matsya is a sacred golden fish rising from the playa the way a creature rises from the deep, unhurried and luminous, as if the desert has always been her ocean. Named for Vishnu's first avatar, the fish who carried light and knowledge into a new age, she travels the Axis Mundi of Black Rock City connecting worlds and strangers. By day a bold yellow sculpted form with dramatic red lips and swept fins. By night a full body lantern glowing from within across the open playa.

name: Onward
description: A Seahorse, piloting a team of Dolphins, on a Tsunami Wave
artist: S.S. Fever Dream by Jael LaFemina

name: Single Track
description: Single Track is a desert scooter built from scratch, using a 5hp gasoline engine with a single track rear snowbike type track as well as a four wheeler front end that gives us the ability to brake and steer.

name: DaVinci Solar Electric Dragonfly
description: Since 2015 the Davinci Solar Electric Dragonfly escorts bicycles and carries up to 6 passengers across playa.

name: Spokes
description:
Spokes started out with the chassis made from all bent tubing from scratch. 

His unique wheels are made from 40" sewer pipe as well as his single rear wheel from a 56" pipe. The rear wheel is also the steering mechanism for the whole vehicle, similar to a forklift.  

It started out as a pedal car over ten years ago at burning man, and is now powered by a 7.5 hp motor

name: Gracie Sandbar
description: A weary castaway's home away from home. A tropical beach shack providing supervised swim, sunbathing, volleyball and refreshments on the playa near you!

name: NeoTrek
description: NeoTrek is the little Choo Choo that could.

name: TMSL MINI ME MIGHTYZENITH ART ATTACK CLASS MODEL 2025 MARK I
description: We are an electric mobile performance stage with a show of Playa All Stars that masquerades as a 1960 Zenith TeeVee Set that lumbers about the Playa - we aim to be the Happiest Talk Show On Earth, where YOU BE THE CONTENT
artist: MiniMe MightyZenith by sTeVe & The sTeVe FreakShow

name: Porch Swing
description: Wooden bench swing on a porch on wheels.

name: The Pegasus: Celestial Chariot
description: The Pegasus, a celestial chariot that will regally transport you through the playa, the galaxy, the heavens and all the way back.
artist: Lunars Camp, Sean Burrow, & Tom Kay

name: Peacekeeper
description: A holographic peace sign on wheels symbolizing peace rising as the sun of a new dawn, Peacekeeper is a soft-glowing, cloud-flanked sanctuary where anyone can climb through the symbol and find their center.
artist: Peacekeeper designed by RADAR, built by Artcarium

name: the red eyed rabbit
description: the red eyed rabbit is a capricious lil dust devil cruising the playa dust waves. be sure to give and wave and a smile. feel free to as for a ride she loves company
artist: the red eyed rabbit by rach goner

name: Don't Fuckin Care Bear
description:
Don't Fuckin Care Bear is a giant, low-poly aluminum bear riding on a glowing white cloud. With blinking LED eyes,
heart-lit feet, and a secret DJ booth in its chest, it's part sculpture, part cuddle-powered dance party, part rolling
emotional support animal. By day it shines like a silver gem; by night it lights up with soft backlighting and playful neon
accents. Built by a diverse, international crew, the bear rolls through the playa as a mobile mood-lifter, offering music,
shade, and joy to anyone who needs a little reminder not to take life too seriously.
artist: Don't Fuckin Care Bear by Grant and Eduardo

name: The Chiton Pickup Car
description:
The Chiton Pickup Car by Doty and the Pickup Car Crew
The Chiton Chapel project companion vehicle for the friends of the Chiton Chapel to spread the love to the Burning Man community at large.
Sonoma County, California
chitonpickupcar@gmail.com
artist: Gary Doty and the Pickup Car Crew

name: Moonbuggy
description: Moonbuggy is a rising crescent moon that glows as bright as the celestial orb in the sky. Her plush white interior quarters cocoon you from the elements, as a disco ball projects an astral landscape onto the surrounding playa. Come cruise the galaxy with us!
artist: Moonbuggy by Katherine Fairfax Wright/Aaron Wilcox

name: Thor
description: Hailing from Denver, CO, Thor is built on a 29' city bus frame to look like the Norse deity Thor flying across the playa. Thor is adorned with a cape-shaded top deck and a massive sheet metal helmet and face, with Jormungandr, a giant LED-backlit sea serpent along one side and custom sound with lightning bolts and a massive LED display panel on the other. Come say hi and grab a ride when you see us roaming the playa!
artist: Thor Art Car by Gas Rag, Morrissey, and Thor Krew

name: The Geode
description: A cracked-open amethyst geode rolling across the playa. Rough and rocky on the outside, glowing purple within. Crystal spires of varying heights surround the driver, lit from within at night. Come find the light inside the rock.

name: Sparkle Pony Xpress
description: The Sparkle Pony Express is ready to provide rides and ice cold water to veteran burners and sparkle ponies alike!

name: Fortress of Solitude
description: Superman's chariot of sound and visual delights.
artist: Fortress of Solitude by Paul Gordon

name: Jealousy the Bear
description: Comparison is the death of joy, and Jealousy is a real bear.

name: Gon KiRin
description:
Gon KiRin (GKR)  is a light dragon sculpture that was conceived by Teddy Lo @teddylostudio, Ryan C Doyle @doylehuge 
& built by a collective of dragon artists.

name: BeOnTv
description:
BeOnTv is a a mobile television and a public performance stage art car where the rider is in the TV and "OnTV" - an integral part of the ride and the entertainment.
Riders will be able to enact "programmed" television shows, dance, or exercise their extroverted mojo.
artist: OnTv by Doug Jackson and the Lunar Disco crew

name: Ivory Tower
description: The  ivory tower glistening rises from the desert. A curved hyperboloid tower from which to see the playa.

name: Grazzhopper
description: Grazzhopper is a green hopping creature providing lounging fun and transportation to migrators of the playa - day and night.
artist: Grazzhopper by Doug Jackson & Lunar Disco crew

name: Moon Child Océanique
description:
A cozy illuminated crescent moon cradle floating on the dried up Lake Lahontan honoring the Pacific Ocean and the majestic Dolphin, Shark and Turtle.

@moon_child_oceanique
artist: Moon Child Océanique by Bruna Burns

name: The GiantCockCar
description: The Playa's biggest COCK (car) - since 2009! The GiantCockCar is a 22 foot tall Peacock riding two rockets.

name: The Canoe
description: the canoe an enjoyable ride on playa

name: Serpent Queen
description: The Serpent Queen is a Victorian Steamboat Time Machine Exploration Vessel Designed by Langhorne Industries, under the auspices of the  Nicola Tesla Propulsion Systems Corporation.  The SQ pulls the Jewel Box Theater Stage, this Show Boat Delights passengers and shore-bound lookie-loos with equal fervor, dispalying astounding feats of old world analogue Theatricality coupled with New World accessible digital Banality.  All are welcome on the Journey of Ten Thousand Lifetimes.
artist: Serpent Queen by JB Henderson and SQ Crew

name: The Taco Disco
description: The Taco Disco is a fanciful art car in the shape of a giant crispy taco. Imagine seeing the taco of your munchy dreams floating across the playa dispensing tacos and great tunes whenever it is stopped, bringing joy to all.
artist: The Taco Disco by the Guild of Eclectic Endeavors

name: Caballo del Sol
description: Life sized rideable horse made from repurposed horseshoes powered by electricity.

name: Purple Panther
description:
The Purple Panther is a bold, geometric mutant vehicle channeling the power, grace, and mystery of its feline
namesake. With a sharply sculpted silhouette, glowing LED patterns, and a commanding presence, it embodies both
strength and femininity. This sleek, two-level art car is designed to prowl the Playa with intention—inviting awe,
connection, and a sense of quiet power wherever it goes.

name: Mystic Flyer Experience
hometown: Cyberius Rex is from Ohio.  The Flyer winters in Las Vegas where Mystic Arts Foundation intends to establish a permanent co-op artist facility to house and maintain and teach others how to collaborate on creating large-scale, transformational art.
description:
Award-Winning Mystic Flyer Experience is an art-centric MV designed to showcase beautiful art & technology through stunning visuals & interactivity. Since 2016, Black Rock City citizens report transformational experiences via our Optical Illusion LED Prism Panels, discovering evening DJ sets, listening to the Consciousness Time Travel Audio Journey, or taking in Playa art from our Roof Deck's vantage point. We will continue gifting this mutant vehicle in 2026 and beyond, adding new artists' work and technologies as funding permits for many years to come.

With love & stardust,
Cyberius Rex, Flyte Attendants, Mystic camp, & Mystic Arts Foundation
artist: Mystic Flyer Experience by Mystic Arts Foundation

name: Toastcar
description: The Toastcar is a tiny electric toaster car built to bring magic into our everyday lives.

name: Dreamy Art Car
description: Dreamy is a radically inclusive platform for connection. We provide a welcoming, relaxed, comfortable and luxurious space to make new friends while enjoying the art.
artist: Dreamy Art car, Simon Barber Amy Fritz Phil Sadow

name: The Buoy
description: Come drift the playa on a ocean buoy setting sail each day on playa.  Take a ride and give the buoy a spin whirling around as desired to get the most panoramic view of the playa
artist: The Buoy by Josh Polito and James Cooley

name: Queen Celestine
description: Dive into the magic of our Celestine Mutant Vehicle, a spectacular fusion of imagination and engineering based on the reliable Yamaha DRIVE Concierge G. By day, it's an enchanting mouse-like masterpiece with a soft, fur-like exterior and whimsically realistic features. As dusk falls, the Celestine comes alive with a symphony of LED lights that outline its form, casting an ethereal glow on the playa. Its illuminated claws hint at playful mischief, while the eyes, nose, and teeth double as innovative headlamps that guide the way through the nocturnal revelry. This mutant vehicle isn't just a mode of transportation; it's a moving installation that captures the spirit of creativity and community, becoming a beacon of tapestry of art.

name: Torch the Dragon
description:
We are grateful to share our fire breathing dragon with you and we invite everyone to come aboard for a ride and encourage you to hit THE BUTTON and take control of the flame effects. Our biggest joy in owning this amazing art car is watching your faces light up (literally) with joy partying with Torch. 

Torch isn't just a mutant vehicle, he's an interactive experience and memory making machine!

name: Lil Warrior
description: Lil Warrior, a tribute to OG Mayan Warrior

name: Hygge
description: Cloud Opera engaging senses through comfort and sound healing

name: Deco Fish Twin #2
description: The Deco Fish Twins are double decker, Art Deco-inspired deep sea fish with an intricate fully addressable LED lighting system, explosive flame effects from its antennae, and a 20,000 Watt pro audio sound system with three zones and room for a dozen bikes.
artist: Deco Fish Twin #2 by the Deco Fish Art Car Team

name: DamnTrak
description: The Historic "Not-Quite Public Transportation" double decker ghost train roams the Nevada desert again!
artist: DamnTrak by Scott Dundas and the Jub Jub Crew

name: DemiTrak
description: DemiTrak is the lil' brother to Damntrak, a sport about for the more personal playa excursions.
artist: DemiTrak by Brian Smith  and Lewis Zaumeyer

name: Moopba Roomba Cat
description: Moopba. A large roomba cat riding on a robot vacuum.
artist: Moopba Roomba Cat by Doug Richards

name: Flying Pegasus
description:
Fulfilling Fanciful Flying Ferry Function (For Fucked-up Flat-Foot)
Large Scale Wire Art Winged Pegasus Art Vehicle presenting in MOBL form providing Playa transportation and refreshments
artist: Flying Pegasus by Sarah Vick & Patches

name: Prism Heron
description: Prism Heron is a faceted metallic bird mutant vehicle: part heron, part prism, part roving light sculpture. Built on a medium-duty truck platform, it carries an angular raised bird head, glowing triangular body panels, a wing-like canopy, and a small rider/music deck. By day it reflects the playa; by night its feather lines illuminate into a copper desert creature moving slowly through Black Rock City.
artist: Prism Heron by Rave Company Art Car Crew

name: Black Rock City Interplanetary Towing Co.
description: Turning Planets in Portals for your towing pleasure! Safety Third!
artist: BRC Interplanetary Towing by Kyrié Wimer

name: The Ticket Booth
description: Get your free drink tickets at the Official Drink Ticket Booth. A drivable ticket booth that transforms from a carnival style ticket booth into a full on DJ booth equipped with pro sound and video.

name: Pacific
description: Pacific is designed and themed in the form of Neptune's Chariot/ It's 22 feet long, 7 feet wide, and 20 feet tall in the front section and is fashioned out of welded steel and adorned with art representing Neptune's colorful world. Pacific is pulled by four 8-foot tall seahorses and covered with colorful lights and is accompanied by dolphins and a 12ft wide manta ray. Neptune drives the chariot.

name: The Beaver Ranch Down Under
description: The Beaver Ranch Down Under, is an old Victorian themed brothel. Run by Kiwi's. It is a people mover that has been modified into an old fashioned building to provide an old world theme to the oldest profession in the world.
artist: Beaver Ranch Down Under by Susan Denham and crew.

name: SuperMod-PediQuad / Pakeyu's Solar Car
description:
the SMPQ is a fully solar powered / electric assisted taxi originally designed as an abstract octopus with flowing tentacles that are now covered in flowers & vines allowing the passengers to be transported through an environment of nature.

The SMPQ ultimately offers a unique silent floating experience as a passenger within, and as a visual spectacle to passerbyers from afar. it runs ALL day long powered by the sun alone, and stores enough energy in the modified battery array to continue all through the night... shuffling strangers to centercamp, a party deep deep playa, the infirmary, home or to find safety with a friend... 

always going to & form every corner of the playa. we have met many a new friend as a result!!!
artist: Pakeyu's Solar Car by Mike Carp
